claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball National Championship game is between the UConn Huskies and Michigan Wolverines.
The game is on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The game starts at 5:50 PM ET.
The venue is Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis, IN.
Tickets are available on Vivid Seats, AXS, and secondary marketplaces.
Ticket prices are listed from under $200 to over $17,000.
UConn advanced after holding off Illinois.
TV channels for the game are TBS, TNT, and TruTV.
